name: More Sparkles!
blurb: Innate: After casting an ability,  Zoe's next basic attack or  Spell Thief bolt within a few seconds will deal bonus magic damage.

effects.description: Innate: After casting an ability, Zoe empowers her next basic attack or Spell Thief bolt within 5 seconds to become non-projectile and deal 16 - 150 (based on level) (+ 20% AP) bonus magic damage.

notes: The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed against  wards.
